native.scope: Owned metadata: same key, identical pitch/duration/alignment; dynamics alone varies. No PCM or Editor; not proof of supplied commercial recordings.

inventory.scope: Hash-pinned metadata only. Exact keys preserve suffix/context; 75-cent windows are descriptive, not manufacturer pitch-layer labels. Constant dynamics does not prove identical recorded vocal effort or absence of every other encoding.

scope: Native same-pitch metadata selection proof; hash-pinned 15-bank metadata; two-bank four-fixture DYN rendering, not evidence of commercial pp/mf/ff recordings.
